subject: Whistic onboarding & evidence indexing — controller access request
messages:
From: Naomi Jacobs <naomi.jacobs@acme.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: security-ops@acme.com
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Whistic onboarding & evidence indexing — initial ask

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Acme is moving quickly on a controller-side audit and we'd like to onboard Redwood into our Whistic profile this week. Two asks to kick off:

1) Can Redwood provide a single manifest (CSV) that maps your SOC 2 evidence files to Whistic question IDs? Our audit tooling needs a mapping column for quick sampling.
2) We need a service account or user with "Controller Read" access in Whistic for our audit automation (read-only). If you have an access-request template, please attach.

I've attached a manifest template and a short checklist (see attachments). Ideal timeline: access provisioned and manifest returned by Tue 9/22 EOD PDT.

Quick context: this is for our internal SOC 2 Type II — evidence will be sampled and pulled into our audit runner. We're not asking for any production data, just evidence possession proofs and CAIQ/SIG mappings.

Appreciate the help.

— Naomi
Naomi Jacobs
Senior Information Security Manager, Acme Cloud Services
naomi.jacobs@acme.com
(415) 555-0123

Attachments: acme-evidence-template.csv (attachment), whistic-access-request-template.pdf (attachment)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Jacobs <naomi.jacobs@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Whistic onboarding & evidence indexing — initial ask

Hi Naomi — thanks for the clear asks and timeline. Looping in Marissa (security portals) and Priya (evidence steward) to align on owners.

Short answers:
- We can produce a CSV manifest that maps our SOC 2 artifacts to Whistic question IDs. Priya will craft the mapping; could you confirm whether you need an additional column for doc-hash or timestamp?
- We can provision a read-only Whistic service account scoped to profile access. That account will have MFA enforced and IP allowlist applied.

Action items I set here:
- Priya to build manifest draft by Mon 9/21 AM PT.
- Marissa to request Whistic service account and share access-request PDF with RBAC details.

I'll need one small clarification: when you say "Controller Read", do you want the account to be able to download attachments (evidence files) or only view metadata and Q&A links? We can restrict to metadata if you prefer download disabled.

Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Security & Sales Liaison
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
(650) 555-0199

Attachment: acme-soc2-evidence-manifest.csv (draft placeholder)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Jacobs <naomi.jacobs@acme.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Sep 2026 08:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Whistic onboarding & evidence indexing — initial ask

Hi Naomi — Marissa here. Ben asked me to handle the Whistic side.

I've submitted the service-account request to Whistic support and included the following controls in the ticket:
- Role: Read-only (Profile Viewer)
- Attachment download: disabled by default; can be enabled per-file if you supply signed URL exceptions
- IP allowlist: Acme CIDR (please confirm the range)
- MFA requirement: enforced

Ticket reference: WHIST-87431 (internal). Whistic estimated 24–48 hours to provision once they validate our org mapping.

Priya attached the first manifest draft below (CSV stub). Naomi: we added a doc-hash column per Ben's question and included a new column "evidence_tier" so your automation can prioritize Type I/II samples. Please confirm whether your tooling expects question IDs in a numeric or slug form — we used slugs.

On attachments: our preference is to keep download disabled and provide short-lived signed downloads on a per-sample basis. If Acme audit tooling requires direct download from Whistic, let us know and we can enable it for the service account with additional logging.

Thanks — will update when Whistic confirms provisioning.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Security Program Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Attachment: acme-soc2-evidence-manifest.csv (attached)

From: Naomi Jacobs <naomi.jacobs@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, security-ops@acme.com
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Whistic onboarding & evidence indexing — initial ask

Marissa — this is great, thanks. A couple quick confirmations: 

- We prefer question IDs as numeric IDs (our import uses numeric keys). Can Priya swap the slugs to numeric IDs?
- Attachment download: disabled is fine. We'll request signed downloads only for sampled artifacts — that workflow works for us.
- IP allowlist: Acme runner IP block is 18.205.0.0/16.

If you can share the manifest with numeric IDs by EOD Wed 9/22 we'll start a small dry-run with our audit runner on Thu. After the dry-run, we'll confirm whether we need download enabled for any specific objects.

Appreciate the speed on this.

— Naomi
Naomi Jacobs
Senior Information Security Manager, Acme Cloud Services
naomi.jacobs@acme.com
